agreed: 2026-11-19 (PLACEHOLDER UPDATE, owner: "Add all possible improvements leaving nothing else out"; master blueprint section 83)
rule: Every screen waits well, hints well and is never empty without a next step. Loading shows cached content first, then (only for content the device has never had) a skeleton shaped like the content, never before 300 ms and never for less than 300 ms once shown, turning into a 'taking longer' note with Retry after 8 s. Every typing field shows a hint: an example, never the instruction; its label always stays visible; sensitive fields (PINs, passwords, card details, one-time and recovery codes, ID numbers) never get an example that looks like a value. Every list and page has its designed empty state with a next step. ts/src/placeholder.ts, web/shell/placeholder.css and shell.ts state() draw them; tests/test_placeholders.py and ts/test/placeholder.test.ts check them. Never filler Latin text, TODO, [Bank] or made-up values on a screen; sample data is labelled Sample.

hint_kinds.note: Format hints are the same in every language and use the reader's own digits; a country hint is the page's own country code; word hints are examples in every language (web/shell hint_*).

due_note: Fields that still need a hint (and two hinted fields that still need a visible label) when this rule was agreed. Section 4 moves every built screen onto the page templates and gives each its hint in every language; the list may only shrink, and section 4 cannot lock while it is not empty. Emptied on 2026-11-21 (section 4 row 83.6, v0.93.0): every field has its hint in every language and the two fields have their names.
banned_note: Patterns (case-insensitive except the capital-letter markers); the first is the classic Latin filler text, written so this file itself passes the visuals gate.

more.agreed: 2026-11-20 (owner: no placeholder improvement left out; blueprint 83.7)
rules: Number hints use the reader's own digits (Arabic-Indic, Bengali, Devanagari and others), like every number on screen
Lists that load more show skeleton rows at the end, then a calm 'That's everything'; pull to refresh shows the same Updating chip
A new item appears in its list at once, marked queued, and moves through the five states
Uploads show the file's own preview with real progress, and wait queued when offline
A picture that fails keeps its shape and shows a token-coloured stand-in with its alt text, never a broken-image icon
Maps and trackers show their steps first and the map after; media shows its frame while buffering
Search with nothing typed shows recent searches and suggestions, never a blank box; suggestions appear while typing
Fields with a limit show a character counter; a disabled field says why and what unlocks it
Typed work is saved as a draft on the device as people type, and offered back after a crash, a timeout or going offline
A paid-tier feature on a lower plan shows what it does with Upgrade or Try, never a hidden or broken screen; never inside payments, counts or signatures
A merchant's logo still waiting for its check shows the business's initials
Spoken interfaces (voice, basic-phone calls, LynkAssist by voice) say once that they are working, never leave silence
Skeletons follow light, dark, high-contrast and sunlight modes from tokens

waits.rule: Every page waits well (83.4): a page with the emulator kit gets it from ts/src/emkit.ts (wireKit after()), any other page calls PageWait.apply (ts/src/emulator.ts pageWaiting) at the end of every draw, with a 'First open' condition in its panel. waits.words: web/wait (loading, Try again, taking longer, Updating, Working, That's everything, First open): the only words a page carries for waiting
